title: Text: DET Drew VerHagen ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey, sorry about the uncertainty with your situation. Are you feeling ok? I’m off this weekend but I woke up to texts from other teams this morning wondering why
Seems weird. Gardy was really short about it this morning, basically saying it was Al’s call, that’s not his department
I feel fine, just giving up too many runs I guess?
